body:
# Beacon programme configuration. Anything not set here takes the default in
# tooling/bcn/config.py. Values marked PLACEHOLDER are unconfirmed with the partner.

[programme]
name = "Beacon example programme"
theme = "default"

[validate]
forbidden = ["semester", "deadline", "next week", "Cohort 7"]

[cues]
min_confidence = 0.8     # start strict; loosen only if a real edited topic proves it necessary
max_divergence = 0.10

[subtitles]
format = "srt"           # PLACEHOLDER: "srt", "vtt" or "both"

[delivery]
transcode = false        # PLACEHOLDER: partner delivery spec unconfirmed

[compose]
layout = "inset"         # PLACEHOLDER: "inset" or "side_by_side"

[bumpers]
intro = ""
outro = ""

[qa]
unit_minutes_min = 85
unit_minutes_max = 110
